bible.text: Before I formed you in the womb I knew you, before you were born I set you apart.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... why do I keep doing this to myself at 1 a.m.? 💔

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: New house. New job. Married, already a father. And I'm still here, still trying to figure my life out.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Whose timeline are you reading -- Mine, or theirs?

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I don't even remember the last time I felt proud of myself.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You're not late. You're not behind. You're exactly where I'm shaping you.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: But my dad still looks at my cousin the way I wish he'd look at me.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: I don't measure you by what he expected. I measure you by what I placed in you before you were even born.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Then why does it still hurt this much?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Because you were made to be seen, not compared. And I see all of you -- not just the parts that are winning.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Maybe I've just been comparing my chapter to someone else's whole book.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: What page do you feel stuck on right now? 🤍
